title: First parade bands: Lacoste, Manuel Perez and Celestine
summary: Morris names brass bands he marched in, playing with Peter Lacoste, Manuel Perez's band and Celestine's Tuxedo.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: We were going to ask about some of the brass bands. What was the first brass band on the parade you played in?
The first brass band on the parade. Let me see, let me see, let me see. I just remember now.
Did your same group with the dance band go out on the parade?
No, sir. I think it was John Kers and me, I think.
Do you remember some of the big brass bands like...
Peter... Peter Lacoste.
Oh.
Yeah, Peter Lacoste. He was an excellent good player. He used to play the Silver Leaf Band, too, with me. And different men, you know, they had for the brass band.
You remember Manuel Perez. You didn't mention...
Yeah, I played with Manuel Perez, too.
Yeah, I played with him when he first come back from California. You know, he come from Chicago, I think it was.
You know, you tell that he was up there.
Yeah, I see, he come back here. Well, he played good after he come back. He played a long time after.
You played his brass band?
Played, yes, I played with him.
What did he call his brass band?
I think the... Ornwood or something that was named.
Have two cornets or three cornets?
Three cornets.
Three cornets. Big?
Yeah, three cornets.
Three corn, Magnolia. Three, four, three.
You remember the old tuxedo brass band? Did you ever play in that?
Yeah, Celestine.
Yeah, did you ever play in that?
Well, I played once or twice with Celestine.
Yeah, Magnolia.
I think I played once or twice with him.
